title: Yellowed Crumbly Egyptian Lamb Kebabs
description: A traditional Egyptian dish featuring lamb, coriander, and binchotan-charcoal, perfect for meal prep. This recipe yields fatty and crumbly kebabs with a unique flavor.
instructions: Preheat the binchotan charcoal grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the lamb shoulder, coriander, onion, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Thread the lamb mixture onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the kebabs with olive oil and grill for 10 minutes per side.
Let the kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving on a tagliere.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve immediately.
Store any leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
Reheat the kebabs in the oven at 350 degrees Fahrenheit for 5 minutes before serving.
